$comment: Every committed version of the site, for the index at / (D39). Newest first. Each commit is built into public/versions/<commit>/ by npm run versions. 'home' is where that copy's homepage lives: empty before D39, 'home' for commits that have src/app/home (the script checks). Text comes from the commit messages and spec/DECISIONS.md only.

directions.name: Direction B
directions.note: The opening reworked as one story (D29), in three options. C1 Horizon is the pick (D35).

directions.name: Direction A
directions.note: The first full homepage, frozen as tag direction-a.

live.title: Working copy
live.summary: What is on screen now, including anything not yet committed. It changes as we work.

versions.title: Three people on the disc; Go deeper scroll bar; lines rise in
summary: The layer's green disc carries three people, after the reference, instead of a single user. Go deeper's list shows a scroll bar on its right edge and its lead photo appears without the halftone dots. The rail's opening three lines rise into place as the section scrolls in.

versions.title: Layer: a user on the disc, the playhead from the start
summary: The green disc in the layer moment carries a user instead of NEAR's N, so the layer reads as yours. The black box on the line now appears around NEAR's tile where AI and blockchain meet and marks your place from there: the tiles stay on the line, a new one lands in the box as the disc turns green, and every tile and the box are one size throughout.

versions.title: Hero versions on the contact sheet
summary: The contact sheet shows the five hero versions, each with a thumbnail of its opening view. Each opens the whole homepage with that hero only, to show them one at a time; the homepage itself still picks one at random.

versions.title: Hero original: even motion
summary: The original ridges hero no longer hitches every fourth frame: its move is re-timed into even steps, with the vector layer moved to match. The first frame is unchanged; add ?hero=original to see it.

versions.title: Hero gate and unfurl: smooth starts and even motion
summary: The bump at the start of the gate's move is edited out, and the gate and unfurl moves no longer hitch every fourth frame: both now run in even steps at 30 fps, with their vector layers re-tracked. Add ?hero=gate or ?hero=unfurl to see them.

versions.title: Hero gate: re-shot with a real crane and clean chrome, re-tracked
summary: The gate hero's camera move is a new take: the camera cranes down the slope while the chrome ring's reflections slide cleanly across it, and every vector mark is re-tracked to it. The other four versions are unchanged; add ?hero=gate to see it.

versions.title: Hero: five versions, one at random on each load
summary: The four hero concepts are now full heroes like the original: a camera move down through the scene, scrubbed by the scroll, with the vector layer tracked to it. Clouds roll round the summit, the fern unfurls with its dew sliding, the dune's light moves like a time lapse with sand blowing, and the gate's chrome reflections shift as the grass blows.
Each load shows one of the five at random, the original included; add ?hero=original, clouds, unfurl, dune or gate to choose one.

versions.title: Hero: four cinematic static options in situ (with the lab links fixed for the frozen copy)
summary: Four options for the opening image, each a generated photograph with a vector layer traced from it, shown as the homepage's real first screen: above the clouds, a fern unfurling, a dune, and a chrome gate in mist.
The homepage is the same as 462e91a.

versions.title: Layer moments in real-time 3D (glass tokens); Go deeper matches the r16/v3 prototype
summary: The rail opens with your data as glass tokens round a frosted core; as the layer becomes user-owned the core grows over them, turns NEAR green and hides them, the N etched into it.
Go deeper now follows the r16/v3 prototype: one lead item and a scroll-held list of rows with thumbnails, mono filters, a halftone entrance.

versions.title: Rail: the identity station, a gimbal in real-time 3D; every station is now live
summary: The identity station is a precision gimbal rendered live: a frosted glass frame, two chrome rings and the green ball at the centre, which never moves. On arrival the inner ring makes its one turn from a ghost of its old angle while a dial on the rim reads it.
At rest the middle ring sways and the vectors keep moving like the other stations'. The static options it was chosen from are on the identity lab page.

versions.title: Rail: the intelligence station in real-time 3D, a green core turning inside the frost
summary: The intelligence station is rendered live like the assets station: a frosted sphere with a clear glass band, a green machined core turning inside it, and a chrome ball outside.

The sphere enters tilted and its band eases level at the centre. The Signed proof tag is gone, and the vectors move: the meridian sways, markers ride the orbits, the request ray grows in and retracts.

versions.title: Rail stations: one green ball on assets, animated vector layers, no tags
summary: The assets station keeps only the green ball with a fading trail, and a second animated layer of dials, markers and drawing arcs around the glass washer.
The data station drops its tag and its vectors move: the rim arc sweeps, markers ride the orbits, the axis draws in and out. Hidden stations stop rendering, so the rail holds 60 fps.

versions.title: Confidential: no crawling or indexing anywhere the site is hosted
summary: The site asks every search engine not to crawl or index it (robots.txt and a no-index header on every response). The pages look the same as 212980b.

versions.title: Rail motion: the data station in live glass, the assets station in real-time 3D
summary: The rail's data station is animated: a frosted glass disc turns flat to camera as it arrives, easing in and out, while the green ball loops behind it, diffused by the glass.
The assets station runs in real-time 3D: two equal balls orbit the glass washer in a seamless loop. Three options were built; the other two stay in the lab.

versions.title: Homepage: Original + Orbit is the main version
summary: The homepage is now the master: the take j pull-back with its tracked lines and dust, and the rail with Orbit's rendered drawings, micro-animations and hover.
The hero layer comes closer to the headline with a long soft feather, varies its greens in five tones, and its tracks are smoothed; the rail's markers are square tiles with the NEAR mark.

versions.title: Hero: the near trees tracked by a second pass run in reverse
summary: Take j's near trees are tracked again, backward from the final frame on brightened frames, so the dots and lines that rise with them stay on the trees.
80 linked points and 450 dust points on the trees; points that slid there are cut, and the earlier stand-ins that flew in from the left are gone.

versions.title: Own-your illustrations, Orbit on the rail, the station dot, a stronger hero layer
summary: Illustration styles for the rail's four stations: eight flat styles and five rendered glass-and-metal hybrids, kept on the contact sheet; Orbit built into the Original with micro-animations and a hover parallax.
The rail's station dot is a green disc with the NEAR mark, the playhead ring centred on it.
The hero's tracked lines are stronger and greener, with isolated clusters, gradients on every line, a softer bottom left and detail on the foreground trees.

versions.title: Homepage directions: Original, A Survey, B Prism, C Field
summary: Three new directions for the whole homepage beside the original, each keeping its flow and content: A Survey (a technical atlas with micrographics), B Prism (vector with frosted glass and refraction), C Field (Swiss editorial from the N's construction).
Each has its own Stack graphic in the same shape and a new treatment for every section below it.
A contact sheet shows every section side by side and lets you pick per section; the homepage is unchanged.

versions.title: Hero: a tracked graphics layer on the pull-back render
summary: The hero gains a layer of fine graphics tracked to the footage (A4 Plexus + Traces): lines draw on and off, dots come and go, nothing runs a light along a line.
A new render (take j, the gentle pull-back) with a subtle green; three graphics options on it, then option 1 composed by the golden ratio over a dust layer, with particles rising off the land.
All in the lab (/lab/hero, /lab/hero-j4); the homepage is unchanged.

versions.title: C1 Horizon: a straight story rail
summary: Rail: a green NEAR tile where AI and blockchain meet; the problem leads straight into “On NEAR, that layer is user-owned.”; a line drawing of the layer replaces the black box.
Stack: the title and lede stay pinned with the tabs; the closing line is gone.
Customer stories carry each company’s own logo. Testimonial options round 3 (H, I, J).

versions.title: Every option, side by side
summary: Hero: a scroll-scrubbed camera move down the ridges; the anthem at h1 size.
The mission and “Own your” as one story, in three options, and the rail in three cinematic looks. The homepage shows option B Sentence.
Go deeper fits one screen with three featured items. Testimonial options rounds 1 and 2.

versions.title: Header hides on scroll; six micro-interactions
summary: The header slides away on scroll down and returns on scroll up.

Small moves: a green packet in the mission, drawings that replay on hover, panels that swap out fast and in slow, a slow zoom on Go deeper images, a rule drawn across Get into NEAR rows, and a chevron that turns into an arrow.

versions.title: Ridges hero still; Pause motion removed
summary: The hero is the layered-ridges still, so nothing auto-plays.
The “Pause motion” button is gone.

versions.title: Lighter Go deeper hover
summary: Hover and keyboard focus lift a strip tile to white and drop the title underline.

versions.title: Go deeper images, round 2
summary: All 12 Go deeper images re-shot as photographs in real light.
The Stack’s closing line sits inside the pin.

versions.title: Flat Stack fade; close as a centred panel
summary: Each Stack ring fades on as one flat image on a long ease.
The close is a centred panel: the N tile, “NEAR belongs to you”, and the email field and Subscribe button as one pill.

versions.title: Whole-ring Stack build; photographic paths
summary: Each Stack ring drops into place as one piece.
Every Go deeper item links. Get into NEAR re-shot as daylight photographs. A light close over a meadow photograph.

versions.title: Stack after your reference; Own your drawings
summary: The Stack’s columns and drawing rebuilt from your Figma reference; on desktop it builds one layer per scroll step.
“Own your”: one hairline drawing per word on the thread. A new rhythm for the opening.

versions.title: Proof strip without footnotes
summary: Figures and captions only; the sources stay recorded in the spec.

versions.title: Polished homepage
summary: Every placeholder marker removed without inventing facts.
Final imagery for Go deeper, Origin and Get into NEAR.

versions.title: The first homepage
summary: Eight sections, the header and the footer, with design-audit fixes.
The hero with the green thread, the anthem, the mission and “Own your”; the Stack in three columns; Proof; Go deeper; Origin; Testimonials; Get into NEAR; the newsletter close.

versions.title: Scaffold
summary: Next.js, the design tokens, fonts and brand marks. The homepage is a placeholder; the system page shows the tokens.
